generationArguments.prompt:
Create ONE brand-new TRANSPARENT PNG sprite atlas of exactly 48 genuinely distinct full-body game poses, arranged in a STRICT regular grid of EIGHT COLUMNS by SIX ROWS. Aim a landscape 1536x1152 or similarly readable canvas. Pixel-game illustration, clean detailed readable anatomy, consistent adult proportions and costume throughout. This is new native drawn animation, not official frames. NO text, labels, numbers, grid lines, background, floor, scenery, extra people or opponents. Keep every full head, hand, whole boot sole, weapon and modest effect entirely INSIDE its OWN equal cell, with at least 20px fully transparent gaps all around. Poses never touch neighboring cells. Small subjects: do not crop any toe or gun tip. All 48 are newly articulated DISTINCT poses: do not duplicate or mirror a pose; do not turn one static drawing into variants by color/translation. Predominantly frontal three-quarter, facing RIGHT; avoid back views so the equipment and anatomy stay unambiguous. Same natural body scale in all 48 cells; genuine crouches remain shorter. IDENTITY AND VERSION: Ash vs Evil Dead, season 1 (2015). Adult Ruby Knowby in her season-1 Lucy Lawless appearance: shoulder-length pink/magenta hair, fair skin, dark fitted leather jacket and dark trousers with boots. Hold the physical ancient Kandarian dagger with a dark textured organic hilt in anatomical RIGHT hand, blade short and entirely contained. No brunette hairstyle, no later-season blonde incarnation, no sword/gun, no giant summoned body or magical aura.
 EXACT ORDER: Each HALF-ROW is one FOUR-FRAME animation, left to right. Row0 columns0-3 INTRO: approach, inspect surroundings, settle equipment/gesture, ready stance. Row0 columns4-7 OUTRO: relax, quarter-turn without a back view, departing step, glance back. Row1 columns0-3 ROUND VICTORY: small relieved nod, brief acknowledgment, weight shift, ready again. Row1 columns4-7 ROUND DEFEAT: restrained flinch, step back, small stabilizing half-kneel, recover. Row2 columns0-3 ADAPTED FINALE (non-gory solo presentation, no execution): Four distinct close defensive dagger poses: bring dagger near shoulder, pivot into a guarded stance, make a short controlled parry motion with no opponent or contact, settle. No magical contract, portal, damage burst or supernatural beam. Row2 columns4-7 OVERALL VICTORY: four distinct restrained satisfied gestures, no new power or equipment. Row3 columns0-3 OVERALL DEFEAT: lower shoulders, crouch, whole-body kneeling/seated disappointment, bowed head; no wounds or missing parts. Row3 columns4-7 SUPER: Four distinct close defensive dagger poses: bring dagger near shoulder, pivot into a guarded stance, make a short controlled parry motion with no opponent or contact, settle. No magical contract, portal, damage burst or supernatural beam. These four super drawings must have genuinely different stance/arm articulation from the four finale drawings, not duplicates. Row4 columns0-3 BASE IDLE: four distinct subtle ready poses with changed arms, head and weight. Row4 columns4-7 BASE RUN: four distinct articulated running-cycle steps facing RIGHT, equipment safe. Row5 columns0-3 BASE ACTION: A short physical right-hand dagger strike in empty air, followed by controlled guard. No magic. Row5 columns4-7 BASE HIT REACTION: four different mild non-gory recoils, brace, stagger, recover; no injuries. Every animation's final fourth pose is recovery with NO muzzle flash or active attack effect. All true drawings, NO code effects, no repeated sprites, no painted backdrop. Keep safety gutters and full subjects for every single cell.
CRITICAL FINAL COMPOSITION CHECK: the canvas MUST contain ALL SIX COMPLETE ROWS, EIGHT complete figures per row =48. Make EACH adult only about110px tall on a1448x1086canvas, leaving generous50px vertical empty gutters and margins, rather than drawing180px figures that cause the bottom row to be cut. Last row includes COMPLETE BOOTS with soles and at least25px transparency BELOW ALL feet. Do NOT omit the defeat or super half-row. Use small coherent game sprites so all48 full bodies comfortably fit.
